source.title: Environment and Climate Change Canada daily climate data (MSC GeoMet OGC API, climate-daily)

note: Estimate (U): weeks per year (Tuesdays) at or below the 10th percentile, a D2-like (severe drought) level, of a station drought index: percentile of the trailing 90-day precipitation (mean of the ECCC stations Salmon Arm CS and Silver Creek) against 1991-2020 for the same time of year; D0 <= 30th, D1 <= 20th, D2 <= 10th, D3 <= 5th, D4 <= 2nd percentile (the US Drought Monitor's percentile guide, applied to rain only). Not the US or Canadian Drought Monitor, which weigh many indicators and expert input. Station point, not a county map; `cells` has one value. Years with < 26 scored weeks are left out.
